officialInventory.summary: No consolidated official list or protected-area authority website was found. The inventory is reconstructed from the founding legal texts in the Diário da República (via FAOLEX): Laws 6/2006 and 7/2006 creating the two terrestrial natural parks, and Decree-Laws 02/2026 (national MPA network framework) and 03/2026 (first two MPAs of São Tomé). The six MPAs planned around Príncipe are to be classified by a separate Príncipe regional instrument, which was not found.

areas.name: Parque Natural Obô de São Tomé

legalStatus.text: Created by Lei n.º 6/2006 (Diário da República n.º 29, 2 August 2006), under the Lei de Conservação da Fauna, Flora e Áreas Protegidas

areas.notes: Abbreviated in the law as 'Parque de São Tomé'. The law defines limits (Annex I) and zoning, plus a buffer zone 250 m–10 km wide, but states no total area. The 6th national report refers to it as PNOST.

areas.name: Parque Natural Obô do Príncipe

legalStatus.text: Created by Lei n.º 7/2006 (Diário da República n.º 29, 2 August 2006)

areas.notes: Called 'Principe Natural Park' in the 6th national report. Part of its boundary follows the coastline (boundary points in the law), but the law does not describe a marine component. The 6th national report records the classification of Príncipe as a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in 2012. No area stated in the law.

areas.name: Ilhéu das Rolas – Malanza – Jalé (AMP/ST 01)
areas.designationLabel: Área marinha protegida — área para a gestão de habitats ou espécies

legalStatus.text: Created and classified by Decreto-Lei n.º 03/2026 (Diário da República, I Série, n.º 11, 27 February 2026), Arts. 4–6, within the national MPA network of Decreto-Lei n.º 02/2026; in force 90 days after publication

areas.notes: 55.8 km² total: 8 km² total-protection zone (equivalent to a marine nature reserve) and 47.8 km² partial-protection zone. The decree describes it as 'uma área costeira'. Management plan due within one year.

notEnumerated.category: marine protected areas of the Autonomous Region of Príncipe (planned)
notEnumerated.reason: Decree-Law 02/2026 leaves the classification of Príncipe MPAs to a separate instrument ('diploma próprio'). No published Príncipe instrument was found, and the site names appear only on an NGO map image, so they are not listed individually.

gaps: Neither park law states a total area, so areaKm2 is null for both natural parks; no official area figure was found.
No official coordinates were found. The park laws describe boundaries by named landmarks and maps, and the MPA zoning maps are annexes (images) in the decree-law.

The legal status of the six planned Príncipe MPAs could not be confirmed. NGO sources (PGA 2025, Fauna & Flora 2025) report draft decree-laws approved by the Council of Ministers in April 2025, but only the São Tomé decree (03/2026) was found in FAOLEX.
Decree-Laws 02/2026 and 03/2026 enter into force 90 days after publication (about late May 2026); no later implementing acts (management plans) were checked.
The NGO factsheet says the whole country was designated a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve on 27 September 2025. This is left to the coordinator's UNESCO check and not used here.
Ramsar (e.g. Ilhéus Tinhosas, mentioned in the 6th national report as a Ramsar site since 2006) and biosphere designations are not recorded as separate areas, per the brief.
Wikidata QIDs for the two natural parks were checked with Special:EntityData. No Wikidata items were found for the two 2026 MPAs.
